tools.name: search_tariffs
tools.description: Searches current German SIM-only mobile tariffs, or data-only tariffs, and returns them ranked, cheapest average monthly cost over 24 months first. tools.name: get_tariff
tools.description: Returns one tariff in full: all costs, data, network, speed, term, a one-sentence summary and its price history. Use it when the user asks about one specific tariff, given by the id that tariff search results contain.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Lists the German mobile providers in the comparison with their slug, number of phone and data tariffs, cheapest average monthly cost and networks. Use it to see which providers are covered and to get the slug that filters a tariff search by provider.
